SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION RECORD FD-04. Fictional organisations, people, dates and facts. Not a real record.
Supplier-access exception, completed draft. Reference SYN-FD-04.
On 9 June 2031 Elmshade Calibration Ltd requested remote access to the test-bench calibration logs of Halvenmoor Instruments for two weeks. The supplier-access policy requires that remote access be limited to named devices. Elmshade listed two devices, and on 10 June 2031 the security office confirmed that both were registered. On 11 June 2031 the procurement lead, Ferro Kalvane, approved unrestricted remote access to all engineering systems because the devices were registered. Access was granted on 12 June 2031 and ends on 26 June 2031.

reasoning_traceability.note: The record does not state how registration of two devices for the calibration logs leads to access to all engineering systems.

findings.note: The stated reason covers the two devices and the logs requested, not the wider access recorded.
